newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor up on speculative buying.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery moved up to 1,135/1,136 rupees per quintal from 1,128/1,129 rupees on renewed speculative buying, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Reports of reduced arrivals at the producing centres and overseas enquiries dragged prices upward," one operator said.
Short covering too helped prices to bounce back after recent losses. Daily inflow of castorseed in the producing centres dropped due to heavy rain.
Groundnut oil was steady at 348/350 rupees per 10 kg, so was imported palm-oil at 260/261 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was quiet at 445/450 rupees per 15 kg.
